     3	 *
     4	 * Renders the full detail page for a single workspace inside a project:
     5	 *   - Workspace header: ID, description, breadcrumb link back to the project.
     6	 *   - Repository status table: one row per repository, showing current branch,

    15	 *     `renderWorkspaceDetail`, which the router calls before navigating
    16	 *     away.
    17	 *   - Actions: "Open in VS Code" button (shown only when workspace is
    18	 *     initialised, dynamically added after a successful Setup — calls
    19	 *     `api.workspaces.launch.vscode`), "Switch Branches" navigation button,
    20	 *     "Rename Workspace" (disabled for STABLE), "Delete Workspace" (disabled
    21	 *     for STABLE).
    22	 *
    23	 * ## Credential-error display
    24	 *
    25	 * When a repository's clone fails because no credential is configured for its
    26	 * host, the setup orchestrators emit an error message containing the sentinel
    27	 * text defined by `CREDENTIAL_MISSING_SENTINEL` ("requires a credential for
    28	 * host"). The view detects this via `applySetupResultCredentialErrors()` and
    29	 * replaces the generic "No data" badge in the status table with an amber
    30	 * "Missing Credential" badge (`.status-badge-credential`) that links directly
    31	 * to `#/repositories/:id` so the user can assign a credential without leaving
    32	 * the workflow.
    33	 *
    34	 * Key helpers in this subsystem:
    35	 *   - `CREDENTIAL_MISSING_SENTINEL` — the exact string matched against error
    36	 *     messages. Must stay in sync with the orchestrator error templates.
    37	 *   - `buildMissingCredentialBadge(repoId)` — renders the amber `<a>` badge
    38	 *     and wires SPA navigation via `_router` (with `href` as a fallback).
    39	 *   - `applySetupResultCredentialErrors(setupResult)` — called after every
    40	 *     setup invocation (Setup button, Retry Setup, health alert) to add or
    41	 *     remove repos from the in-memory `credentialErrorRepoIds` Set and update
    42	 *     their badge cell in the DOM immediately.
    43	 *   - `applyStatusMapUpdate()` — clears the credential-error flag when a repo
    44	 *     transitions from no-data to having live status data (i.e. after a
    45	 *     successful re-clone following credential assignment).
    46	 *
    47	 * **Known limitation:** `credentialErrorRepoIds` is an in-memory Set populated
    48	 * only by explicit `setup()` calls during the current page session. If the page
    49	 * is reloaded after a prior credential-missing failure, the badge will not
    50	 * appear until the next Setup run because the error state is not persisted in
    51	 * the workspace health report or the status map. Surfacing this on page load
    52	 * would require a new API endpoint or server-side persistence — out of scope
    53	 * for the current implementation.

    57	 * The view uses the same router-injection pattern as `project-detail.js`:
    58	 * `app.js` calls `setRouter(router)` before `router.start()`. The `_router`

    61	 *
    62	 * ## Cleanup contract

    24	/**
    25	 * Branch Switch Wizard — Repo Parallelizer GUI.
    26	 *
    27	 * A 3-step wizard that guides the user through selecting a target branch,
    28	 * assigning per-repository branch overrides, executing the switch, and
    29	 * displaying per-repo results.
    30	 *
    31	 * ## Steps
    32	 *
    33	 *   Step 1 — Choose Branch
    34	 *     Fetches branch data via `api.branches.list()`. Displays a text input for
    35	 *     typing a branch name and a `<datalist>` of pre-computed suggestions for
    36	 *     quick-pick. "Next" validates input and advances to Step 2.
    37	 *
    38	 *   Step 2 — Assign Per-Repo Branches
    39	 *     Table with one row per repository. Each row has a text input (pre-filled
    40	 *     with the Step 1 branch) and a `<select>` dropdown. The Step 1 branch
    41	 *     appears in a separate "Selected" `<optgroup>` at the top; choosing a
    42	 *     dropdown option copies the value into the corresponding text input.
    43	 *     "Back" returns to Step 1 preserving the branch name; "Confirm" submits.
    44	 *
    45	 *   Step 3 — Results
    46	 *     Calls `api.branches.switch()` with the collected assignments. Displays a
